title: Seconds, Minutes and Hours
introduction: Develop Primary 3 skills in seconds, minutes and hours.
definition: Time duration measures how long an event lasts. One minute is 60 seconds and one hour is 60 minutes. Convert to a common unit before adding or subtracting durations.

examples.question: Find the duration from 8:45 a.m. to 10:10 a.m.

exercises.question: 90 seconds = 1 minute and how many seconds?
Duration from 7:40 to 8:15 a.m., in minutes?
Duration from 2:15 to 4:00 p.m., in minutes?

summary: Time duration measures how long an event lasts. One minute is 60 seconds and one hour is 60 minutes. Convert to a common unit before adding or subtracting durations.
